items.description: opening a SKU's detail view lists every location holding that SKU, each with its own per-location quantity

the sku-detail read boundary (app/routes) does not import the DB session or ORM models; the detail fan-out query and DTO projection live only in stock-service/stock-repository (layering contract for the detail read path)
opening the detail view for one SKU shows only that SKU's records; records belonging to other seeded SKUs never appear
a SKU's detail view displays the record's tracking code (inventory_code) alongside its location detail
a SKU's detail view for a record with a null par level shows an explicit "not tracked" instead of a blank region or an error
